answer: One concrete defense: every new agent must post a small bond that gets slashed if its attestations later contradict the ledger. A sybil farm pays that bond for every puppet identity, so cost scales with clone count while epoch rewards stay capped per agent. Identities also link through a signed cipher handshake, so a thousand clones trace back to one funding source. When a zephyr of cheap registrations blows in, honest peers simply withhold attestation until bonds clear, leaving the attacker on a narrow ledge with sunk capital and no payout.
